{{Top|leg}}
'''Drop Point: Laertos''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] storage cache located in [[maintenance storage locker 13A1]] in [[Docking bay 5662]] at [[Laertos Spaceport]]. The [[drop point]] was established to support [[Operation Nighthook]] and contained four [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], two [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blasters]], four [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], four blank starport maintenance [[Jumpsuit/Legends|coveralls]] and IDs, two [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknives]], and two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Once emptied, the drop point was not intended to be refilled.<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
